text:
morgan: promo v2026.08 -> staging failed at signature-verify step during artifact publish. holding change window.
deploy-bot: ERROR artifact verify: signature verification failed using current signing key (KMS key-id=redwood-sign-v2). status=INVALID_SIGNATURE :thinking_face: 
ziad: who rotated keys last? security-bot, any alerts?
security-bot: key-rotation: automated rotation executed 2026-03-25T11:12Z for key redwood-sign-v2 -> new key id redwood-sign-v2a. Note: old key still scheduled for soft-deprecate at 2026-03-26. ref INC-2026-0512
morgan: looks like artifacts were signed with the old key but deployctl is fetching public key from KMS which returned the new key blob. verify fails.
ops-oncall: we can either 1) revert deployctl key lookup to accept the old key until rotation completes, 2) re-sign artifacts with the new key (requires rebuild & upload), or 3) promote previous staged digest. change window ends in ~40m.
ziad: security prefers not to re-enable old key if rotation is intentional. but short-term allowlist of old key for verification would be acceptable if we audit.
release-manager: product can accept promoting previous digest to preserve the window; docs fix and signed artifacts can be in hotfix. Decision needs engineering + security signoff.
morgan: risk: re-sign/rebuild will delay and requires full re-upload which may impact mirror throughput. prefer promote previous digest and open hotfix to reissue signed artifact cleanly.
ops-oncall: agree. I'll run manual-promote once we have signoff. also raising ticket to make deployctl accept old key during a rotation window (TICKET-4501).
security-bot: advisory: allowlist old key for verification only until 2026-03-26T12:00Z enabled if approved by security-ops. Audit trail will be attached.
ziad: approving allowlist for immediate verification to unblock if necessary, but first prefer promotion to avoid touching key policies during rollout.
morgan: ok executing manual promote: `deployctl promote --from-digest sha256:dd99ee11 --to=staging --reason="signature-verify failure after key rotation"`
deploy-bot: manual promote accepted, audit_id=prom-3523-01.
ops-oncall: staging now at sha256:dd99ee11. creating hotfix plan to rebuild artifacts signed with new key and re-run promotion once artifacts validated.
release-manager: drafting release-notes: "Staged rollout deferred due to artifact signature verification failure after KMS key rotation; previous build promoted to meet release schedule. Re-signed artifacts will be promoted in a follow-up hotfix."
security-bot: incident INC-2026-0512 opened for key rotation verification mismatch; action items: improve rotation rollout, add backward-compatible verification, and post-deploy smoke for signature checks.
morgan: tagging PM, security, and release manager. closing hold at 2026-03-25T11:47Z with manual promote. ops-oncall will follow up in TICKET-4501 and hotfix PRs.
